items.title: AI 작곡·보컬 노래가 결국 음원차트 1위가 됐다 ①
items.excerpt: 창작자 머무르의 '꿈꾸던 어른이 되었나요?'는 수노(Suno)로 보컬을 생성하고 기획·작사·프로듀싱은 직접 맡은 곡으로, 멜론 등 음원차트 상위권에 오르며 AI 제작 음원 표기 의무 등 제도 논의를 다시 불러왔다.
items.rationale: A Suno-vocal track topping Korean charts is a concrete milestone and reopens AI-labelling rules in the home market.

items.title: Suno is 'far beyond' 2m subscribers and $300m in revenue, says Mikey Shulman – who argues it's 'good' that AI music has no 'firm rules of the road' yet
items.excerpt: Suno CEO Mikey Shulman says the v6-era service has passed 2M subscribers, sets out what WMG and BMG get from their licensing deals, and argues about who should set AI music's rules.
items.rationale: First on-record detail of what WMG and BMG get from their Suno licences, plus Suno's scale, from its CEO.

items.title: How Seoul Institute of the Arts Students Use Suno | In The Cut
items.excerpt: Suno visits Seoul Institute of the Arts in South Korea to show how music students use Suno to sketch song ideas, experiment with vocals and harmonies, find chords, and separate stems in Suno Studio before continuing work in their existing DAW workflows.
items.rationale: Practical workflow footage: Korean music students using Suno Studio for sketching and stems before moving into their DAW.

items.title: Feds Want Nearly 4 Years in Prison for AI Music Fraudster Who 'Stole Millions'
items.excerpt: Prosecutors want convicted AI music fraudster Michael Smith, who used AI-generated songs and bot streams to collect about $8M in royalties, to get nearly four years in prison; he is asking for probation.
items.rationale: Government's own sentencing ask in the first AI-generated-song streaming-fraud prosecution; AI songs are central to the scheme.

https://www.musicbusinessworldwide.com/s.new_action: Suno CEO publicly discloses subscriber/revenue scale (>2M subs, >$300M) and the terms WMG and BMG receive under their v6 licences; this is new information, not the original deal announcement.

https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music.new_action: New filing: prosecutors' sentencing memo seeking nearly 4 years; the 9/29 card covered only the defence's request for probation.

dedup.note: Dropped as duplicate: MusicTech 'death of Suno' Reddit v6 backlash. It is the same story as the musicradar card of 2026-09-18 (users slam v6), and labels' 'poisoned tree' line repeats the 2026-09-22 MBW second-lawsuit card. Dropped on relevance: DMN Spotify editorial playlist decline. AI slop is only one factor among fake-account crackdowns, so the story stands without the AI angle. Also dropped The Verge Splice CEO interview, an opinion/interview piece with no new release or decision. Shipping 4 picks because the pool held 7 and only 4 passed; nothing was added as padding. Outlets: isplus, MBW, Suno YouTube, Rolling Stone (4 distinct).
